exposure: maternal serum vitamin D-binding protein (VDBP) levels
cervicovaginal fluid vitamin D-binding protein (VDBP) levels
cohort: A total of 138 pregnant women were divided into three groups: threatened preterm labor (TPL), preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM), and control.
finding: Both serum and cervicovaginal VDBP may be valuable markers for predicting preterm birth, with cervicovaginal fluid VDBP also predicting a short latency period.
